notes.fa: TwinPanel 1.1.0-rc.467 مصرف CPU مسیر Modern Accounting را با حذف تکرار O(nodes × credentials) در ساخت device mapping کاهش می‌دهد، بدون تغییر cadence، قوانین quota، accounting، session، tunnel، routing، credential یا protocol dataplane. در Worker اختصاصی Modern/Sing-box، active ProtocolCredentialها، legacy SubscriptionNode membership و QuotaDeviceها در هر reconcile Session یک‌بار bulk-load می‌شوند؛ payload هر credential یک‌بار decode می‌شود و همان mapping فقط تا پایان همان Session reuse می‌شود. Sweep بعدی Session و cache تازه دارد، بنابراین تغییرات credential بین چرخه‌ها پنهان نمی‌شوند. منطق canonical first-match، dedupe، telemetry identity و lazy QuotaDevice backfill حفظ شده است. PR #1729 با 6/6 Workflow شامل Modern Accounting، Sing-box Accounting، API Build/integration، Preview، Tunnel و Telegram سبز Merge شد و Release PR #1730 نیز 9/9 Workflow سبز Merge شد. Source روی SHA immutable 5f6ead13b82bcc1813d07caa55daa13b5b4ef5de قفل شده است.
notes.en: TwinPanel 1.1.0-rc.467 reduces Modern Accounting CPU by eliminating repeated O(nodes × credentials) device-map construction without changing cadence, quota, accounting, session, tunnel, routing, credential or protocol dataplane semantics. In the dedicated Modern/Sing-box worker, active ProtocolCredentials, legacy SubscriptionNode membership and QuotaDevice rows are bulk-loaded once per reconcile Session; each credential payload is decoded once and the resulting mapping is reused only for that Session. The next sweep gets a fresh Session and cache, so credential changes cannot be hidden across passes. Canonical first-match, dedupe, telemetry identity and lazy QuotaDevice backfill behavior are preserved. PR #1729 merged with 6/6 green workflows including Modern Accounting, Sing-box Accounting, API Build/integration, Preview, Tunnel and Telegram, and Release PR #1730 merged with 9/9 green workflows. Source is pinned to immutable SHA 5f6ead13b82bcc1813d07caa55daa13b5b4ef5de.
